'''Tyler Pate''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Georgia State Championship]] on 25 March 2000 with [[ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|ISB/IAO]], according to Charlie Herren's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d509">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-12-ga-state-championsip-25-march-2000d509/ ga-state-championsip-25-march-2000], DeckTech (Charlie "Bad Player" Herren, 12 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-12-ga-state-championsip-25-march-2000d509/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
